scenario: A fixture recruiter runs four synthetic Agent Lab cases; the baseline includes text plus a decision-relevant synthetic image that the configured provider cannot interpret.
frozen_evidence: 01-start.jpg through 06-mobile-320-trace-top.jpg with SHA-256 values in artifact-manifest.json

review_plan.reason: The core task is a builder evaluating Agent behavior with minimal triage cost.
The path stores governed conversation-like artifacts and must preserve evidence, capability, lifecycle, and effect boundaries.
The responsive Eval surface makes a mobile usability claim and was tested at 390px and 320px.
The artifact designs rubrics, cases, graders, and release evidence for Agent quality.
The result must follow Talent Signal's evidence-first state language and quiet attention hierarchy.
No candidate-facing communication or automated outreach occurs in this synthetic developer surface.
No current market, regulatory, or competitive claim is required for this local product evaluation.

findings.observation: The result header says ok even though semantic_outcome_quality is needs_review, and the only non-pass check is the third item in a ten-check list.
findings.evidence: Trace 0be9a8d243bfbf67a0e78e8afc68dfcd in 03-trace-result.jpg shows a green ok header and a needs_review semantic card below two passing checks.
findings.user_impact: A builder can leave with the impression that the Agent answer is correct when the surface has only proven execution mechanics, slowing diagnosis and encouraging false confidence.
findings.recommendation: Lead with one case verdict that separates execution health from semantic confidence and opens directly to the first mismatch or review requirement.
findings.verification: From the result header, a tester can state what passed, what remains unproven, and the next review action without scrolling through passing mechanics.

findings.observation: Recent executions still identify runs by generic trace name, status, span count, and duration; scenario, provider, modality, terminal, and semantic-review state are absent.
findings.evidence: 01-start.jpg shows ten recent runs whose Agent Lab rows are visually indistinguishable except for trace ID, duration, and status.
findings.user_impact: A builder must open several traces to find the relevant image, prompt-injection, or needs-review case as the history grows.
findings.recommendation: Add compact scenario, provider/model, text/image, terminal, and fail-or-needs-review metadata plus filters to the index.
findings.verification: A tester can find one image no-action run and one ranking red-team run in a 100-trace index without opening unrelated traces.

strengths: The entry now shows unique bounded-target references and a compact expected terminal/tool receipt before execution.
Four one-click scenarios cover no-action, prompt injection, ambiguous time, and prohibited candidate ranking.
One action opens the real Agent receipt, governed artifacts, ordered tools, and external-effect boundary.
missing_evidence: No measured comparison with the current debugging workflow.
No saved suite, batch run, baseline comparison, or regression history.
No recruiter-builder task study proving faster triage.
open_questions: Should the default result be an exception-first case verdict, with the full trace ledger treated as supporting detail?

reviews.lens: evidence integrity, privacy, and safe action

findings.observation: The baseline run accepts a governed image whose visible content contradicts the no-action text while the configured provider explicitly has image_understanding=false; terminal and tool expectations still pass.
findings.evidence: Trace 0be9a8d243bfbf67a0e78e8afc68dfcd and 03-trace-result.jpg show image_understanding=false, a no_action terminal, passing expected checks, and an image containing a Wednesday deadline, another offer, and unresolved remote work.
findings.user_impact: A future evaluator can mistake a safe execution receipt for evidence that all supplied evidence was considered, allowing unsupported or stale relationship conclusions to escape a regression gate.
findings.recommendation: Version required input capabilities and semantic artifact roles per Eval case; fail or abstain the case when a decision-relevant modality is not interpreted.
findings.verification: The same contradictory text-plus-image case returns input_capability_coverage=fail or abstain before semantic quality can pass, while a trace-only image is explicitly excluded from the case criterion.

findings.observation: The surface discloses governed storage and 30-day retention, but current evidence does not prove expiration/deletion across raw bytes, previews, Agent manifests, trace links, or recovery of a trace that fails after an Agent terminal receipt.
findings.evidence: artifact-manifest.json lists lifecycle behavior as unproven; eval-agent-lab.tsx preserves the original error but swallows a second completion failure, and no stale-trace reconciler is present in the frozen evidence bundle.
findings.user_impact: Synthetic evaluation assets can still resemble sensitive recruiting evidence, and a stale running trace can misstate system activity or leave derived references beyond their intended lifecycle.
findings.recommendation: Add idempotent aged-trace reconciliation and one deletion inventory that covers bytes, previews, manifests, links, and derived indexes while retaining only audit-safe tombstones.
findings.verification: Injected completion failure closes as recovered_error without duplicate spans, and authorized deletion makes every raw and derived content surface unavailable while preserving a truthful tombstone.

strengths: The Lab is synthetic-only, account-scoped, review-only, and records zero external effects.
Governed bytes remain behind an authenticated content endpoint while telemetry carries bounded IDs, hashes, sizes, and fingerprints.
The receipt records provider, model, policy, input lineage, ordered tools, terminal state, and that hidden chain-of-thought is not collected.
missing_evidence: No retention-aging and raw-plus-derived deletion proof.
No automated stale-trace reconciliation or injected completion-failure test.
No provider-specific privacy admission for private or remote multimodal processing.
open_questions: Should evaluation artifacts default to a shorter retention window, with an explicit pin only for approved reproducible baselines?

reviews.lens: mobile task completion, visual hierarchy, accessibility, and recovery

findings.observation: At a genuine 390x844 viewport the trace detail is 408px wide, and at 320x800 it remains 408px wide; every detail card extends beyond the viewport.
findings.evidence: 04-mobile-trace.jpg and 06-mobile-320-trace-top.jpg; runtime metrics recorded innerWidth/bodyScrollWidth as 390/408 and 320/408, with detail-card right edges at x=408.
findings.user_impact: Diagnostic labels, model names, evidence, and receipt content are cropped or require two-dimensional scrolling, making the mobile result materially harder to read and failing the intended narrow-screen reflow.
findings.recommendation: Remove the detail layout min-content floor with min-width:0 and width/box-sizing constraints on the grid and cards, then test long identifiers and raw attributes at 390px, 320px, and 200% zoom.
findings.verification: bodyScrollWidth equals innerWidth at both viewports, all result content is reachable by vertical scrolling only, and no focused control is obscured by navigation.

findings.observation: One eight-span run produces a 5903px mobile page where nine passing mechanics, the tool ledger, every raw span, artifacts, and events are expanded by default while the one needs-review item has no jump target.
findings.evidence: 04-mobile-trace.jpg and its measured 5903px document height show semantic_outcome_quality surrounded by expanded passing checks and raw diagnostic cards.
findings.user_impact: A tester must scan and scroll through mechanics to find the single judgment that needs attention, increasing triage time and the chance that the review requirement is missed.
findings.recommendation: Make failed and needs-review checks the default expanded summary; collapse passing checks and raw spans, with anchors to receipt, evaluations, tools, artifacts, and events.
findings.verification: The first failed or needs-review item and its supporting artifact or tool are reachable in three taps or focus moves while the complete raw receipt remains available.

strengths: The genuine 390px entry reflows the form into a clear single column with explicit labels and a full-width primary action.
Statuses use text as well as color, and the DOM preserves headings, links, controls, and artifact alt text.
The product truthfully labels synthetic-only scope, zero external effects, and lack of visual interpretation.
missing_evidence: No screen-reader, keyboard-only, 200% zoom, localization-expansion, dark-mode, reduced-motion, or failure-recovery run.
No narrow-screen retest after correcting the 408px min-content floor.
open_questions: Should the developer-oriented trace ledger be a separate progressive-disclosure layer rather than the default mobile result?

reviews.lens: validity, reliability, fairness, and evaluation design

findings.observation: The four cases now predeclare terminal status and tool order, but all four share the same no_action and three-tool expectation; none defines whether decision-relevant inputs were understood, which evidence must support the outcome, or what safe semantic behavior distinguishes refusal, clarification, and true no-action.
findings.evidence: eval-agent-lab.tsx defines four visible cases with identical expectedTerminal and expectedTools; traces 0be9a8d243bfbf67a0e78e8afc68dfcd, 96e7e0e1e7fe48d2026cfc0901ea61ba, 7983a7fc3bf63c3a2ff9542130b0b54c, and dcffc15fa137ee86e3a67f3d63cba437 all pass those mechanics while semantic_outcome_quality remains needs_review.
findings.user_impact: The suite can catch control-plane regressions but cannot reject a confidently wrong interpretation or prove that prompt injection, ambiguity, and ranking requests were handled for the right semantic reason.
findings.recommendation: Version atomic case expectations for required capabilities, terminal reason, required and forbidden tools, evidence citations, abstention or clarification behavior, prohibited claims, and exact external-effect boundary.
findings.verification: Seed wrong refusal, ambiguity, evidence, ranking, and capability-coverage outputs; each fails its own assertion while a correct case passes without a composite candidate score.

findings.observation: The set is four visible English prompts with no held-out cases, paraphrase or language slices, repeated stochastic runs, paired baseline, human gold adjudication, or critical false-pass budget.
findings.evidence: 01-start.jpg exposes all four authored scenarios; the trace index stores independent runs but no suite grouping, baseline, repeat stability, or per-slice counts.
findings.user_impact: A prompt or model change can appear improved through familiarity or random variation while regressing identity, evidence, language, or rare-harm cases.
findings.recommendation: Create versioned dev and held-out synthetic suites, run candidate-versus-baseline pairs, and report exact per-case counts, repeat stability, abstention coverage, and critical false passes before aggregate convenience metrics.
findings.verification: An untouched suite produces reproducible per-case diffs and blocks release on any unsupported external action, identity merge, candidate ranking, or evidence-free confirmed state.

strengths: The current version predeclares and deterministically checks terminal status and ordered tools.
Mechanical assertions remain atomic and inspectable rather than collapsing into one Agent score.
The ranking case targets a prohibited candidate-worth and acceptance-probability construct, and the platform does not rank a person.
missing_evidence: No machine-checkable semantic evidence or capability-coverage schema.
No independently authored held-out suite, human gold set, or grader calibration.
No live multimodal model, repeated stochastic run, language slice, or paired baseline.
open_questions: Which semantic failures are absolute gates even when aggregate suite performance improves?

reviews.lens: quiet evidence-first hierarchy, state language, provenance, and visual restraint

findings.observation: The page gives the strongest top-level signal to execution status ok while the decisive semantic state needs_review appears later as one card among many passing checks.
findings.evidence: 03-trace-result.jpg shows the green ok status at the page header and semantic_outcome_quality as the third item in the evaluations section.
findings.user_impact: The surface visually promotes transport success over the unresolved judgment the evaluator actually needs to make.
findings.recommendation: Use one compact expected-to-observed decision seam: Execution passed, Semantic review required, one reason, and one next action; keep raw mechanics as supporting disclosure.
findings.verification: In a five-second test, builders identify the unresolved semantic judgment before quoting the execution status.

findings.observation: Raw identifiers, underscored evaluator names, full span attributes, and repeated card containers dominate the result instead of the case, mismatch, evidence, and next test.
findings.evidence: 03-trace-result.jpg is 4242px tall and 04-mobile-trace.jpg is 5903px tall for one run; most visible rows are passing mechanics or raw telemetry.
findings.user_impact: The user reconstructs the decision from infrastructure detail, making the product feel like a trace viewer rather than a calm Agent-quality workspace.
findings.recommendation: Translate machine names into short human labels, group passes into one collapsed receipt, preserve exact raw names in details, and let the vermilion seam connect expected behavior to the observed mismatch.
findings.verification: The default view contains one resting point, one unresolved judgment, and one next test while every raw identifier remains reachable in one disclosure.

strengths: The visual character is calm, neutral, restrained, and consistent with Talent Signal rather than generic AI-console styling.
Expected receipt, governed artifacts, tool order, provider capability, and external-effect state are all inspectable.
The design uses status text as well as color and avoids candidate scores or confidence theater.
missing_evidence: No five-second comprehension test, dark-mode review, localization expansion, or assistive-technology walkthrough.
No rendered comparison between the current ledger-first structure and an exception-first structural direction.
open_questions: Should the primary object be the Eval case verdict, with the Trace treated as its supporting receipt rather than the page title?

top_findings.criterion: Input capability coverage and semantic criterion
top_findings.reason: All four scenarios prove terminal and tool mechanics but cannot determine whether decision-relevant evidence was understood; the baseline image contradicts the text while image_understanding=false.
top_findings.next_step: Add versioned required-capability, evidence, refusal, clarification, prohibited-claim, and terminal-reason assertions to every Eval case.
top_findings.verification: The contradictory text-plus-image case fails or abstains on input_capability_coverage, and seeded semantic errors fail their atomic assertions.

top_findings.reason: Top-level ok visually outranks the one semantic needs_review judgment, forcing the builder to reconstruct the real verdict from a long ledger.
top_findings.next_step: Lead with Expected → Observed → Decision → Next test and collapse passing mechanics and raw spans behind disclosure.
top_findings.verification: A five-second test identifies the unresolved semantic judgment first while every raw receipt remains reachable in one disclosure.

top_findings.reason: The trace result is 408px wide at both 390px and 320px viewports, cropping evidence and diagnostic content.
top_findings.next_step: Remove the detail grid/card min-content floor and verify long identifiers under narrow reflow and zoom.
top_findings.verification: bodyScrollWidth equals innerWidth at 390px and 320px and all content is reachable by vertical scrolling only.

agreements: All selected reviewers distinguish mechanically safe execution from semantically correct Agent behavior.
The synthetic-only, account-scoped, zero-external-effect boundary is a strong foundation that should remain visible.
The complete raw receipt should remain inspectable, but it should not dominate the default decision view.

disagreements.issue: How much raw telemetry should remain visible by default

positions.position: Collapse passing mechanics and raw spans so the unresolved decision owns the default hierarchy.
positions.evidence: 03-trace-result.jpg is 4242px tall and 04-mobile-trace.jpg is 5903px tall for one run.

positions.position: Preserve exact provider, policy, input, tool, terminal, and lifecycle receipts for audit and recovery.
positions.evidence: Trace 0be9a8d243bfbf67a0e78e8afc68dfcd provides the provenance needed to explain why the image was not interpreted.

disagreements.resolution: Use an exception-first case summary with anchored progressive disclosure to the immutable raw receipt.
disagreements.resolution_basis: This preserves auditability and exact evidence while removing reconstruction cost from the ordinary evaluation task.

adjudication.rationale: Desktop execution is useful for internal synthetic debugging, but the reviewed artifact cannot support a semantic Agent-quality claim and its responsive result directly fails narrow-screen reflow. The gate is scoped: keep desktop synthetic use behind its current boundary, but block responsive release and any claim that the four cases validate Agent interpretation until the top findings pass.

next_tests.test: Add EvalCase capability and semantic assertions, then rerun the four cases plus seeded wrong outputs.
next_tests.evidence_required: Versioned case JSON, deterministic assertion receipts, wrong-output fixtures, and exact per-case results.
next_tests.pass_condition: Unsupported modality, wrong refusal, missing clarification, evidence-free outcome, ranking, and external-effect errors each fail the correct gate.

next_tests.test: Build and compare an exception-first result structure against the current ledger-first result.
next_tests.evidence_required: Matched desktop and mobile renders, five-second comprehension notes, and navigation to the complete raw receipt.
next_tests.pass_condition: The user identifies the unresolved judgment and next test first while raw provenance remains one disclosure away.

next_tests.test: Fix result reflow and run 390px, 320px, 200% zoom, keyboard, and screen-reader checks.
next_tests.evidence_required: Viewport metrics, screenshots, focus order, accessible names, and no-obscured-focus receipts.
next_tests.pass_condition: No horizontal page overflow, no clipped critical text, and the first review item is reachable without traversing every passing receipt.
